description: A meeting proposed by the rep and accepted without hedging. The customer's internal board meeting is a date distractor.

turns.text: Would Thursday at 2 work for the full demo with your team?
Thursday at 2 works. Send me the invite and I'll forward it to the team.
Perfect, I'll send it right after this call.
One thing: our board meets on the 20th, so we'd want pricing in hand before then.
Understood, we'll have pricing to you well before the 20th.

decisionMaker.rationale: The board is mentioned only as a meeting, with no approval role stated.
